Tooltip_KFM_Exam: Check the patient's general state, temperature, pulse, hydration and healing. What you notice depends on First Aid level. A stethoscope counts as +1 level; a tongue depressor (used up) lets anyone check hydration and throat.
Tooltip_KFM_Irrigate: Flush an open, unbandaged wound with 0.25 L of water. Clean water lowers wound infection; tainted water makes it worse. Weaker than disinfectant, and it stings.
Tooltip_KFM_Tourniquet: Arms and legs only. Stops the bleeding of this part and everything below it while applied. Buys time to stitch or bandage; it is not a treatment. After a few hours the limb starts to suffer.
Tooltip_KFM_TourniquetRemove: Removes the tourniquet and gives it back. Untreated wounds below it start bleeding again.
Tooltip_KFM_Cauterize: Close a deep wound with a heated blade (uses a lighter or matches). Leaves a burn that needs cleaning. Worse than stitches, better than bleeding out. Does not work on bites.
Tooltip_KFM_ReduceFracture: Set the broken bone back in place: much faster healing, extremely painful. Once per fracture. The patient must be sitting or lying down. Painkillers taken before halve the pain.
Tooltip_KFM_Debride: Cut away badly infected tissue with a scalpel. Clears the wound infection but the wound bleeds again: bandage it afterwards. Never affects any other infection.
Tooltip_KFM_ImprovisedTourniquet: Cloth strips and a stick used as a windlass. Use it from the health panel on an arm or leg.
